stages.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: Castellan RTS castle damage-stage sprite, first of two matching states.
Input image 1 is the exact original castle and the edit target.
Primary request: edit this SAME medieval brutalist castle into a readable 25% DESTRUCTION state (about 75% architecture still intact), with the first localized visible fires, like classic RTS building damage states.
Preserve the original elevated isometric front/right camera, perspective, all surviving stone masses in their original positions, original scale, building footprint, center and ground/base alignment. Same tall central keep, outer towers, recessed arched gate, gray flag mast/banner. Do not redesign the castle or rotate it.
Damage: a quarter of the crenellations and some outer parapet/corner stone are broken; a few deep masonry cracks and scorch marks; a small breach in the front-left outer wall with fallen blocks immediately at that base. Main keep and all main towers remain standing, the entrance is recognizable. Damage should be clear at small game size but this is early damage, not a ruin.
Fire: a few compact warm orange/yellow flames emerging from the damaged upper parapet and the small front wall breach. Fine dark gray wisps of smoke only, no large smoke cloud. Fire must be readable without obscuring the castle. Stone and banner remain neutral grayscale, ONLY flames have warm color, ready for later separate flame animation.
Style: match exact reference detailed sculptural 3D game art, upper-left lighting, rough gray monolithic stone, clean readable silhouette; no baked dithering or pixelation.
Output: one complete isolated castle sprite on a genuinely transparent RGBA background, enough empty transparent margin to preserve every flame, smoke tip and rubble fragment, no floor plane or cast ground shadow, no scene, no lettering, no labels, no percentages, no comparison panel, no watermark. Same composition and camera will be reused for the later 75% destruction state.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: Castellan RTS castle damage-stage sprite, second of two matching states.
Input image 1 is the pristine ORIGINAL castle, the exact geometry/camera/alignment reference. Input image 2 is the already generated 25% destruction state and is the EDIT TARGET. Continue destruction of this exact SAME castle, not a different fortress.
Primary request: a very clear 75% DESTRUCTION state (only about 25% of the architecture survives), with larger localized fires, following classic RTS damage progression. This must be dramatically more ruined than image 2; do not merely add cracks and smoke to an intact castle.
Preserve the original elevated front/right isometric camera and perspective, original footprint, scale, center, entrance/base alignment and surviving stonework positions. Keep the same neutral-gray medieval brutalist monolithic stone architecture and upper-left light. Do not recenter or enlarge the ruin to fill the space freed by missing upper walls.
Damage progression: the front-left breach has widened and that left outer tower and most front battlements have collapsed to low broken masonry. Most of the high central keep's upper stonework, roof deck and crenellations are missing, leaving an unmistakable jagged broken hollow remnant at roughly half its original architectural height, with visible shattered floor slabs. The original flag mast has snapped and fallen onto that remnant, with torn light-gray cloth still identifiable. The front arch is severely broken but a remnant marks the original gate position. Much of the outer right-side upper tower is also destroyed; retain a partially standing right buttress/tower shell so the castle is recognizable and asymmetrical. Fill the missing masses with believable low piles of large fractured stone blocks on the ORIGINAL footprint and immediately around its base, including existing damage sites from image 2.
Fire: 3–4 readable orange/yellow fires in the hollow central keep and wall breaches, larger than in image 2, with restrained translucent charcoal-gray smoke wisps. Flames are the only warm colored areas; architecture and banner remain grayscale. Smoke must NOT hide the architecture or fake its destruction. This is a still burning damaged building, not yet the final total rubble death state.
Style: same detailed sculptural 3D game sprite as both references, crisp readable masonry, no baked dithering or pixelation.
Output: one whole isolated sprite with TRUE transparent RGBA background, same portrait canvas/framing and ground position as image 2. Keep every rubble fragment/flame/smoke tip in frame with clear alpha around them. No scene, ground plane, cast shadow, text, labels, percentages, panels or watermark.
stages.review: Selected by user: the intermediate damaged castle is preferred over the later severe ruin.

next_step: Animate both approved fire states and regenerate their falls using Hugging Face, then map fire pixels to particles with an explicit game dither ramp.
